3.name: Tool Proficiency & Experimental Elixir
3.description: Gain proficiency with alchemist's supplies and brew Experimental Elixirs with random or chosen effects during a Long Rest or by spending spell slots.

5.name: Alchemical Savant
5.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to one healing roll or Acid, Fire, Necrotic, or Poison damage roll when casting an Artificer spell through alchemist's supplies.

9.name: Restorative Reagents
9.description: Creatures drinking your Experimental Elixir gain 2d6 + INT modifier Temporary HP; cast Lesser Restoration INT modifier times per Long Rest without a slot.

15.name: Chemical Mastery
15.description: Gain Resistance to Acid and Poison damage, immunity to the Poisoned condition, and cast Greater Restoration and Heal once per Long Rest without a slot.

3.name: Tools of the Trade & Arcane Armor
3.description: Gain Heavy Armor proficiency and smith's tools; turn armor into Arcane Armor removing Strength requirements, usable as Guardian (Thunder Gauntlets, Defensive Field) or Infiltrator (Lightning Launcher, +5 ft speed).

5.name: Extra Attack (Armorer)
5.description: Attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

9.name: Armor Modifications
9.description: Your Arcane Armor counts as separate chest, boots, helmet, and weapon items for Artificer Infusions, and your maximum infused items increases by 2 for Arcane Armor pieces.

15.name: Perfected Armor
15.description: Upgrade your Arcane Armor model: Guardian pulls and blasts foes within 30 ft; Infiltrator grants Advantage and extra 1d6 Lightning damage once per turn.

3.name: Tool Proficiency & Eldritch Cannon
3.description: Gain woodcarver's tools proficiency and conjure a Tiny/Small Eldritch Cannon (Flamethrower, Force Ballista, or Protector) fired with your Bonus Action.

5.name: Arcane Firearm
5.description: Carve sigils into a wand, staff, or rod; add 1d8 extra damage to one damage roll of any Artificer spell cast through it.

9.name: Explosive Cannon
9.description: Your Eldritch Cannon's damage increases by 1d8, and you can detonate it as an action dealing 3d8 Force damage in a 20-foot radius.

15.name: Fortified Position
15.description: Have two Eldritch Cannons active simultaneously and grant Half Cover (+2 AC and DEX saves) to allies within 10 ft of a cannon.

3.name: Battle Ready & Steel Defender
3.description: Gain Martial Weapons proficiency, use INT for magic weapon attack/damage rolls, and command a loyal Steel Defender construct using your Bonus Action.

5.name: Extra Attack (Battle Smith)
5.description: Attack twice, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

9.name: Arcane Jolt
9.description: When you hit with a magic weapon or your Steel Defender hits, deal 2d6 extra Force damage or heal 2d6 HP within 30 ft (INT modifier uses/Long Rest).

15.name: Improved Defender
15.description: Arcane Jolt scales to 4d6, your Steel Defender gains +2 AC, and its Deflect Attack deals 1d4 + INT modifier Force damage.

arcane_jolt.name: Arcane Jolt
arcane_jolt.hint: Once per turn, on a magic weapon hit or your Steel Defender. Can heal instead.
